explained.summary: People exist for one another’s sake. So either teach them better or put up with them. There’s no third option of resenting them.
explained.today: When a colleague keeps making the same mistake or a relative repeats the same annoying habit, you can explain kindly, or you can let it go. Complaining about them to everyone else isn’t on the list.
